items.quote: Several respondents noted that Ven Selova took ownership of steadying the unit after its flagship project was cancelled and steered it to completion.
Peers observed that Ven led reaching a deal with the contractor after weeks of back-and-forth across the department.
Direct reports said that Ven Selova drove media interviews and press conferences for the whole division.
Ven handled root cause analysis of recurring service failures competently within her team.
Ven Selova set the direction for efforts to keep unions, grassroots leaders and trade associations on side across the public service.
Several respondents noted that Ven headed efforts that helped three direct reports earn promotion, setting priorities for several teams.
Several respondents noted that Ven Selova was recognised sector-wide for her leadership of upholding governance and audit standards.
Direct reports said that Ven Selova led piloting new approaches to grant applications across the department.
Peers observed that Ven championed the partnership with sister agencies on youth services and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
She spearheaded drafting legislative amendments for the new act at the national level.
